subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should plugin release publishing automatically generate README-based package changelog previews for existing packages, with publisher-member and staff access to prior release README context?
rationale: The code now has a plausible access gate, but this is a new public publish-page workflow and storage/AI summarization boundary that needs maintainer intent rather than an automated assumption.

options.title: Accept auto-preview after proof
options.body: Land this direction once real browser proof shows auto-fill and stale manual-edit preservation, keeping publisher-member and staff authorization as implemented.

options.title: Tighten to manage-only access
options.body: Require owner/admin-level package management access before reading prior release README storage if publisher-role members should not preview history.

options.title: Keep changelogs manual-only
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if maintainers do not want automatic package changelog previews on the publish route.

recommendation.title: Accept auto-preview after proof
recommendation.body: Land this direction once real browser proof shows auto-fill and stale manual-edit preservation, keeping publisher-member and staff authorization as implemented.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is a requested reviewer and the recent history owner for the active package publish and changelog surfaces.
